comments.note: The query-string parsing pattern (url.indexOf('?') + URLSearchParams) is now used in three places in matchRoute(): the existing ?wp= handler, and the two new ?format= handlers. Could be DRY'd into a small helper (e.g. parseQS(url)) if more query params are needed in future routes.

summary: All 4 AC verified by code inspection of gui/server.ts and full test suite execution.

Both namespaced (/api/projects/:repo/:slug/chunks/:filename/rendered) and deprecated (/api/projects/:slug/chunks/:filename/rendered) handlers correctly parse ?format=structured from the raw url via URLSearchParams.
When format=structured: returns { blocks: DialogueBlock[] }; otherwise returns { content: string } — backward compatible.
TypeScript compiles clean; full suite 3381/3381 pass with no regressions.
Coverage gap noted: no unit tests for the structured-format branch path.

comments.note: No unit tests exist for the new ?format=structured branch in the /rendered route handlers. Existing tests (dialogue-qa.test.ts) mock the /rendered endpoint with { content: ... } confirming backward compatibility, but the structured-format path is only verified by code inspection. A dedicated route-integration test file or an addition to the dialogue-qa.test.ts mocks covering format=structured would close this gap.

Case-sensitivity: `format === 'structured'` is an exact lowercase match. ?format=STRUCTURED (uppercase) would fall through to the legacy content handler. This is correct standard query-param behavior but worth noting if client code is generated dynamically.

summary: WP-004 passes review on all four dimensions. Implementation is minimal, surgical, and exactly matches the WP specification.
Both route handlers (namespaced and deprecated) follow the same correct pattern: parse qStr from raw url via url.indexOf('?'), construct URLSearchParams, gate on format === 'structured'.
Security: the namespaced handler correctly runs SAFE_SLUG_REGEX validation before the format branch executes, so validation is never bypassed.
No blocking issues. One documentation-forward and a test coverage gap note recorded.

comments.note: In the namespaced handler, `new URLSearchParams(qStr).get('format')` allocates and immediately discards a URLSearchParams object. The existing convention in this file is `const sp = new URLSearchParams(qStr)` (named variable, reused). The WP-004 handlers are consistent with each other but diverge from the named-variable convention used at lines 382, 538, 557, 775, 805, etc. Not a correctness issue — pure style.

No unit or integration tests cover the ?format=structured route branch introduced by this WP. The QA agent verified by code inspection only. Future work should add route-level tests (e.g. mocking handleGetChunkFile in a server.ts test) for the structured-format path of both the namespaced and deprecated /rendered handlers.
